judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across all provider rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, ignoring rounds without reported usage and returning `undefined` when no rounds report usage. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including testing two tool rounds (three provider calls), updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and making the signature explicit via a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias (note the issue specifically listed `src/types/ai.ts` under key files). Compared to the reference, the candidate introduces the `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias rather than only renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`, places the new tests in a separate acceptance test file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and updates the `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` bullet under the 'Measured semantics' section rather than moving it up to the main requirements section.
